title: 优化器自定义参数（原始格式）

standard.summary: 以原始字符串格式传递优化器参数，支持更复杂的格式（如嵌套结构）。
standard.effect: 与 optimizer_args 功能类似，但允许直接传递 Python 字面量格式。
standard.whenToUse: 需要传递复杂嵌套参数时使用。普通参数建议使用 optimizer_args。
standard.avoidWhen: 大多数情况使用 optimizer_args 即可。

standard_en.summary: Passes optimizer parameters as a raw string, supporting more complex forms (nested structures, for instance).
standard_en.effect: Functionally similar to optimizer_args, but it allows Python literal syntax to be passed straight through.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need to pass complex nested parameters. For ordinary parameters use optimizer_args.
standard_en.avoidWhen: optimizer_args is enough in most cases.

advanced.principle: 后端通过 ast.literal_eval 或 eval 解析，允许更复杂的数据结构。
advanced.tradeoffs: 安全性略低（eval 解析），建议只填写可信内容。

advanced_en.principle: The backend parses this with ast.literal_eval or eval, allowing more complex data structures.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Slightly less safe (eval parsing); only fill in trusted content.
